new_today_news.headline: Utility rate increases proposed for Olympia in 2026
new_today_news.summary: Thurston County Waste Recovery Center tipping rates are increasing in 2026, with garbage disposal rising to $133 per ton from $119 per ton and organics tipping fees increasing to $75 per ton from $37 per ton, impacting Olympia's waste management costs.

recent_news.headline: EPA Announces August 3, 2026 Decisions on Petitions for RFS Small Refinery Exemptions
recent_news.summary: The EPA announced decisions on six individual small refinery exemption petitions from four refineries for the 2023 and 2024 RFS compliance years. This regulatory action affects renewable fuel volume requirements and RIN generation across the biofuel industry.

recent_news.headline: GFL Environmental Responds to Unsolicited Take-Private Expressions of Interest
recent_news.summary: GFL has received unsolicited preliminary expressions of interest from multiple parties to take the company private, as is often the case when there is a valuation disconnect. The Board has formed a special committee of independent directors to oversee any discussions that might ensue. There can be no guarantee that any expressions of interest will result in a transaction.

recent_news.headline: First Expansions Lead Emerging U.S. Restaurant Growth in 2026
recent_news.summary: RestaurantData analysis shows that first-expansion units account for 41% of planned 2026 restaurant transitions, with 3,342 records tracking growth-stage restaurants. The Southeast leads with 30.6% of records, while Texas, California, Florida and New York account for over half of planned activity.

recent_news.headline: Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scarce and Expensive: Why e-SAF Capacity Severely Lags Mandated Demand
recent_news.summary: IATA reported in June 2026 that EU and UK SAF mandates require approximately 600,000 tonnes of e-SAF by 2030, yet global operating and under-construction capacity stood at only 20,000 tonnes with one production site operating. The article discusses UCO-based HEFA pathways and the feedstock constraints limiting SAF scale-up.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q2 2026: EBITDA Triples on Diamond Green Diesel Renewable Diesel Rebound
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported combined adjusted EBITDA of $742 million for Q2 2026, a 197% increase YoY, with its Diamond Green Diesel joint venture generating $389 million in adjusted EBITDA. DGD sold 348.8 million gallons of renewable fuels at $2.23/gallon EBITDA, with Q3 2026 production projected at approximately 335 million gallons amid tight RIN markets and strong demand for low-carbon fuels.

recent_news.headline: Emerging Restaurant Brands: 2026 New Weekly Alerts Report
recent_news.summary: As of August 2026, 548 actively expanding restaurant companies operate 10-50 units while 111 expanding companies have 51-100 units. The report tracks companies moving through the 2-to-19-unit range across broader company sizes.

recent_news.headline: GFL Environmental Q2 2026: Revenue Up 11%, Updated Full-Year Guidance
recent_news.summary: The company now expects revenue of between $7.51 billion and $7.53 billion. Adjusted EBITDA is projected to reach approximately $2.29 billion, while adjusted free cash flow is expected to total approximately $900 million.

recent_news.headline: Clean Harbors Raises 2026 Full-Year Guidance After Record Q2 Performance
recent_news.summary: Clean Harbors posted record second-quarter 2026 results, driven by strong demand across its Environmental Services (ES) and Safety-Kleen Sustainability Solutions (SKSS) businesses. The company also announced a major long-term disposal contract, a strategic acquisition to expand its Field Services business, and increased its full-year guidance.

recent_news.headline: Clean Harbors Announces 10-Year Disposal Agreement Worth $600 Million
recent_news.summary: The company also announced a 10-year disposal agreement with a manufacturing customer expanding its U.S. operations. The contract has an estimated value of $600 million and is expected to begin in the fourth quarter, contributing roughly $10 million of revenue in 2026. Clean Harbors expects the agreement to reach full capacity in 2030, when it could generate an $80 million to $100 million annual revenue run rate.

backfill_news.headline: Hazardous Waste Transportation Regulations Updated
backfill_news.summary: Title 40 CFR Part 263 was last amended on July 27, 2026. Updates govern standards applicable to transporters of hazardous waste, including DOT compliance requirements.
